q: How does your recruitment process work?
a: We begin with a detailed consultation to understand your requirements, then conduct targeted candidate sourcing, rigorous screening, and present a curated shortlist for your review.

q: What industries do you specialise in?
a: We operate across 20+ industries including IT & Technology, Engineering, Finance, Healthcare, Construction, Manufacturing, Logistics, and more.

q: How quickly can you provide candidates?
a: Timelines depend on the complexity and seniority of the role. For most positions, we can deliver an initial shortlist within 1–2 weeks. We set clear timelines at the start of each mandate.

q: What types of positions do you recruit for?
a: We handle everything from graduate and junior roles through to senior management and C-suite appointments across permanent, contract, and temporary positions.

q: What does a recruitment partnership involve?
a: A recruitment partnership means we act as an extension of your team — with a dedicated consultant, agreed service levels, regular reporting, and preferential terms for ongoing collaboration.
